observations: Photo 0 shows a used car tire lying flat on tiled flooring with tread visible; a second tire is partially visible at the top edge and a hand appears at the bottom right.
Photo 1 shows the same tire from the same angle with a hand at the edge; watermark text reads "D-KACHI ENTERPRISE".

Photo 2 shows two tires stacked; the top tire sidewall has partial lettering beginning with "MASTER" but the full brand and model are not legible; watermark text reads "POSTED ON JIJI" and "D-KACHI ENTERPRISE".

claims.evidence: photos show used tread but no grade marking, origin, or Tokumbo certification

claims.claim: will last almost like new brand ones
claims.evidence: future durability and remaining life cannot be judged from still photos

claims.claim: implied good condition with no hidden damage
claims.evidence: no close-up of sidewalls, bead, inner liner, repairs, or date code

risks.risk: sidewall cracks, bulges, patches, or repairs
risks.proof: close-up photos of the full sidewall and bead area of each tire
photo of the DOT manufacture date code on each sidewall
tread depth gauge reading or close-up with a scale
video of the tire inflated and inspected or submerged for leaks

risks.risk: tires are mismatched or sold as a pair when only one is shown
risks.proof: photo showing both sidewall size and brand markings together

proof_requests: Close-up of the DOT date code on each sidewall
Tread depth measurement for each tire
Full sidewall photos showing any cracks, patches, or repairs
Photo of both tires' size and brand markings side by side
response.reason: The photos identify used car tires, so a worst-case price can be set despite unverified condition claims; proof of age, tread depth, and sidewall integrity would raise the value.
